extracted.intended_audience: Applicants and their representatives filing the PCT national phase at the EPO (patent attorneys/agents, applicants)
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural and documentary requirements for entering the European (EPO) national phase from an international (PCT) application, including translations, sequence listings, biological deposit particulars, fee payment/selection of states, and requests (e.g., early processing).

rubrics_metrics.name: Comments on Written Opinion / Supplementary International Search Report
rubrics_metrics.description: Comments on the written opinion established by the EPO as the International Searching Authority and/or observations given in the Supplementary International Search Report established by the EPO as the Supplementary International Searching Authority (Rule 45bis.7(e) PCT).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Where necessary, further details should be submitted on an additional sheet. Observations and comments arising from the ISA/SISA reports may be included to support proceedings before the EPO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Basis of Proceedings before the EPO (documents to be relied upon)
rubrics_metrics.description: Proceedings before the EPO as elected/selected Office (PCT I/II) are to be based on the documents on which the international preliminary examination report is based, including any annexes, unless replaced by the amendments enclosed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If amendments are enclosed (e.g., under Article 19 or 34 PCT), they replace the corresponding parts of the international preliminary examination report for the basis of EPO proceedings. Ensure all referenced annexes are supplied or translations provided where required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of Test Reports received by EPO as ISA/Authority
rubrics_metrics.description: If the EPO, acting as ISA/IPER authority, has received test reports, these may be used as the basis of proceedings before the EPO.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supply copies or indicate availability of such test reports so the EPO may rely on them in the national phase proceedings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Page-count and additional fee calculation information (sections 6.1 and 6.2)
rubrics_metrics.description: For applications comprising more than 35 pages, indications regarding the calculation of the additional fee should be given in the table on page 8.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When the application exceeds the threshold page count, provide the required breakdown in the specified table to enable correct calculation and assessment of any additional fees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Copies of Search Results for Priority Applications (Rule 141(1) EPC)
rubrics_metrics.description: For each of the previous applications whose priority is claimed, a copy is attached of the search results produced by the authority with which the previous application was filed (Rule 141(1) EPC).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach the search result reports from the earlier-filed applications whose priority is claimed, as required by Rule 141(1) EPC.

rubrics_metrics.name: Translations of the International Application (required EPO language translation)
rubrics_metrics.description: Translations in one of the EPO official languages (English, French, German) of the international application (description, claims, any published abstract and any indications under Rule 13bis.3 and 13bis.4 PCT regarding biological material) are to be submitted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide full translations of the international application into an EPO language. Certain translations (e.g., priority application translations) may be required only upon invitation (Rule 53(3) EPC).

rubrics_metrics.name: Translation of Amended Claims under Article 19 PCT
rubrics_metrics.description: Translation of the Article 19 PCT amended claims together with the statement under Article 19, if the claims as amended are to form the basis for the proceedings before the EPO (see Section 6).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you want the EPO proceedings to be based on claims amended under Article 19, supply the translation of those amended claims and the Article 19 statement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Translation of Annexes to the International Preliminary Examination Report (PCT II)
rubrics_metrics.description: In proceedings before the EPO as Supplementary/Selected Authority (PCT II), a translation of the annexes to the international preliminary examination report must be provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure any annexes to the IPER relied upon in PCT II proceedings are translated into an EPO language and enclosed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Declaration re: International Application as Translation of Earlier Application (Rule 53(3) EPC)
rubrics_metrics.description: It is hereby declared that the international application in its originally filed form is a full translation of the earlier application (Rule 53(3) EPC).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When claiming that the international filing is a full translation of a prior application, include the formal declaration to that effect as required by Rule 53(3) EPC.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biological Material — Deposit and Particulars (Rule 13bis PCT / Rule 31 EPC)
rubrics_metrics.description: If the invention uses and/or relates to biological material deposited under Rule 13bis PCT and Rule 31 EPC, the particulars referred to in Rule 31(1)(c) EPC must be given (depository institution name/address, accession number, pages/lines in publication or translation containing particulars).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the depository details as published or in the translation submitted under Section 7 (page/line references). Include the receipt(s) of deposit issued by the depositary institution (enclosed or to be supplied later). A waiver of the right to an undertaking under Rule 33(2) EPC should be attached on a separate document when applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sequence Listing Format and Content (WIPO Standard / Rule 5.2/13ter)
rubrics_metrics.description: The sequence listing (nucleotide and amino-acid sequences) must be furnished in a format complying with the WIPO Standard applicable on the international filing date (Rule 5.2(a) PCT or furnished under Rule 13ter.1(a) PCT to the EPO as ISA), and the listing must not include matter going beyond the content of the application as filed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit the sequence listing in the current WIPO standard format or indicate availability to the EPO; ensure the listing does not add new subject matter beyond the originally filed disclosure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Designation of Contracting States (Article 79(1) EPC)
rubrics_metrics.description: All contracting states party to the EPC at the date of filing that are designated in the international application are deemed to be designated (see Article 79(1) EPC).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Check that the intended EPC contracting states are indeed designated in the international application; no separate designation is required for those states that were party at filing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extension / Validation to Non-Contracting States and Fee Payment Consequences
rubrics_metrics.description: The international application is deemed to be a request for extension/validation of the European patent to non-contracting states designated in the international application with which extension/validation agreements were in force on the filing date; the request is deemed withdrawn if the extension or validation fee is not paid within the prescribed time limit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Pay extension/validation fees within the prescribed time; otherwise the extension/validation request will be considered withdrawn. Provide intended states and pay applicable fees.

rubrics_metrics.name: Selection/Intention to Pay Extension or Validation Fees (and Automatic Debiting)
rubrics_metrics.description: Indication of the states for which extension and/or validation fees are intended to be paid. Note: under the automatic debiting procedure, only fees for the states indicated will be debited, unless the EPO receives other instructions before the payment deadline.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clearly mark the states for which fees should be debited. If using automatic debiting, send any contrary instruction before the payment deadline to avoid incorrect debiting or failure to pay intended states.

rubrics_metrics.name: Waiver of Undertaking (Rule 33(2) EPC)
rubrics_metrics.description: A waiver of the right to an undertaking from the requester pursuant to Rule 33(2) EPC should be attached (on a separate document) when applicable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Attach the waiver document separately if the applicant waives the undertaking required by Rule 33(2) EPC.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acceleration / Early Processing Request (Article 23(2) / 40(2) PCT)
rubrics_metrics.description: Early processing of the application pursuant to Article 23(2) / 40(2) PCT (a request for early entry into the European phase) may be requested.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Be aware of the requirements for an effective early processing request and its legal consequences; consult the EPO leaflet to Form 1200 (Merkblatt zum Formblatt EPA 1200) for details.
